summary: Worked on making Gizmo registry extensions take effect live without restarting agent-server. Read registry/extension source files, the registry-live-reload prompt, and existing tests; began writing new source files (event-replay.ts, SessionSyncCapability.ts, transcript-settle.ts). Then in the browser, clicked Unlink on the Codex Gizmo extension and verified its status bar item disappeared from the main view without restart, then re-Install linked it again (link landed on disk but UI hadn't refreshed yet by last check).
decisions: Link/unlink/install of registry extensions should update the running UI immediately via a rescan hook on the server plus a client refresh and one shared merge helper, rather than requiring an agent-server restart.
Keep the change minimal: two layers (rescan hook, client refresh) plus one shared merge helper and tests; anything else goes in the PR description.
Unlink is non-blocking — no confirm dialog — verified by inspecting ExtensionsSettings.svelte before clicking.
Added new app-side modules: apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/agent-store/event-replay.ts and SessionSyncCapability.ts to handle snapshot/event replay and queued resyncs for session state.
errors: After clicking Install for Codex, the link landed on disk and in ~/.gizmo/registries/installed.json (codex re-listed under gizmo-registry) but the Extensions settings UI did not yet show the Unlink Codex button, suggesting the client refresh path is not yet wired to refresh after the registry install.
Dev server log shows repeated ECONNREFUSED on 127.0.0.1:8787 (vite ws proxy to agent-server) — server appears down or unreachable, which may also explain the missing UI refresh.
